title: From plate to preview.
body: Keep objects, tool assignments and output together.

It does not establish a physical print. https://github.com/Jbyjre/Deja_VU1/blob/main/docs/slicing-and-models.md

title: Catch the mismatch.
body: Read the checks before you start the job.
alt: Confirm Print refuses an unsafe sample file and lists the reasons. Simulated printer.
limit: Checks help review a job; print success is not guaranteed
caption: Confirm Print checks the job again on the server when starting. Blocking errors refuse the start; warnings need acknowledgement. This unsafe sample is shown on the simulated farm. These checks are not a guarantee of print success. https://github.com/Jbyjre/Deja_VU1#why-it-exists
purpose: Show a concrete example of a refused start
primaryText: Read the checks before you start the job. Physical U1 testing pending.
